data.name: Learn_N1
data.value: Images, templates, videos and GIFs open side by side in the tray. Switch between them with a click.

data.name: Learn_N2
data.value: Smart Redact, Smart Move, Auto Simplify, Grab Text and Edit Text work on your own computer. Models download only when you choose to use them.

data.name: Learn_N3
data.value: The library is a plain folder you choose, backups are a single file, and nothing is sent anywhere unless you share it.

data.name: Learn_Step1
data.value: Press the capture hotkey (PrintScreen by default) or choose New Capture. Drag a region, click a window, or pick the full screen, then choose image, video or scrolling capture.

data.name: Learn_Step2
data.value: Pick a tool on the toolbar. Arrows, callouts, text, steps, stamps, blur and more stay editable until you flatten or export. Use Quick Styles on the right to reuse your favourite looks.

data.name: Learn_Step3
data.value: Open the Effects panel to add borders, shadows, torn edges, colour changes and more. Save combinations as Quick Effects.

data.name: Learn_Step4
data.value: Use the Share button to save, copy, print, email or upload to any destination you have set up in Preferences.

data.name: Learn_Step5
data.value: Every capture is kept in your library. Search by what is in the picture, filter by application, website, date or tag, and pin your favourites to the tray.

data.name: Learn_T1
data.value: Choose Image → Smart Redact. Review the categories found (faces, emails, numbers…), pick blur, pixelate or solid, then press Done.

data.name: Learn_T2
data.value: Use the Step capture preset, click through your task, and the editor opens a guide with numbered steps. Combine screenshots with File → Create Image from Template.

data.name: Learn_T3
data.value: Open a video, drag across the timeline to select a range, then Cut Out removes it or Trim keeps only it. Every change can be undone.

data.name: Learn_T4
data.value: In the video view choose Create GIF, pick a preset (screen video, high motion, small file) and optional fade-out.

data.name: Learn_T4T
data.value: Turn a video into a GIF

data.name: Learn_T5
data.value: Choose the Move tool and turn on Smart Move. Buttons and panels become objects you can move, resize or delete.

data.name: Learn_T5T
data.value: Move things around in a screenshot

data.name: Learn_T6
data.value: Choose Edit → Grab Text, or use the Grab Text tool to drag over a region. Copy the result as text or as a table.

data.name: Learn_T6T
data.value: Copy text out of an image

data.name: Learn_Tagline
